description: If the proof presentation \(P\) is consistent and negation-complete, the specified two-sided search returns true on \(n\) if and only if \(n\) has an accepted proof.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.search_correct
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.ProofPresentation)
  (hc : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Complete P)
  (hk : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Consistent P) (n : ℕ) :
  true ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.search P n ↔
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveTheories.Provable P n
